author: Jakk3
quote:
This is the kind of game that I would score a solid 7 or 8 if it didn't have a story, just a simple sandbox to mess around in. Even the sandbox part of it feels like a side-grade at best compared to previous GTA's, it has it's charm, but it's only because the rest of the market is completely incompetent right now.

The graphics are decent, but it doesn't really have a unique aesthetic to it like previous GTA's did. The details are all good, but the overall impression is kind of bland. The best way to describe it is brown. It's overwhelmingly brown. I expected a much more vibrant and eye catching color palette from a game set in Vice City. 

Now to the story...

No, just simply no. I couldn't finish this. I'm not even going to talk about Lucia specifically because neither of the main characters are lovable or even at least likeable, it's full of filler missions, grocery getting, chore simulators and the dialogs are either trying to be funny really hard, they are straight up cringe or just awfully written. What do you mean you renovate your home for Lucia, let her stay with you after ghosting you and cheating on you before she went to prison, you buy her a bunch of stuff, do a lot of her little side quests and when you ask her to just let you speak to YOUR OWN CHILD that she kept a secret from you, she just tells you "no, he's good" with a straight face. 

I lost interest in the story completely. I tried having some fun on the open world but it got boring pretty fast. I have way better things to spend my time with than this. This game has been a complete ripoff for me. It literally managed to make me angry, an achievement that very few games managed to get from me. I literally just made this account to vent about it. I have it uninstalled currently and not planning on installing it again anytime soon. It's just not worth my time and it for sure wasn't worth my money.
